description: The attempt log of a product's latest drive: every attempt with its time on the drive's clock, route, result and evidence, the tips for its owner, and the record's parts (bot checks, ways in, pay, plan, terms, errors, times). Needs your API key with a data plan, Builder ($49 a month) or Team: order product builder, then pay_order (paid over HTTP 402, no domain to prove). Without a plan, one product's log costs $0.50, no key needed: POST https://agentdrives.com/api/paid/detail/<slug> answers 402 with x402 and MPP challenges; pay one and send it again.

slug.description: The product's directory slug, from search_tools (e.g. 'attio')

name: drive_detail
title: A drive's attempt log
